players.product: UPS systems, switchgear, busway and rack PDUs

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 and full-year tracking (CEO Paulo Ruiz): 'We had a very strong July, also very strong August. We are aiming at the high end of the guidance for everything we tracked', and at the high end for the full year (organic growth guidance went 8% to 10% to 12% this year). Drivers: 16 of the 24 facility expansions are in ramping phase (later he said 18 of the 24 are behind Eaton); pricing actions in April and in August plus selective repricing of backlogs; Electrical Americas revenue per day is up 25% versus January last year, including 8% sequential growth from Q1 to Q2. 2027 set-up: Boyd counts as organic growth from Q2 next year and the Mobility separation via the Reverse Morris Trust with Dana is on track; after deploying $13 billion in acquisitions Eaton expects bolt-ons, mainly in Electrical, but no large acquisitions in the next couple of years.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 and FY2026 aiming at the high end of guidance; 16 of 24 facilities ramping; price actions in April and August

quarterly_data.signal: 2030 targets (Ruiz): asked whether the $31 billion 2030 Electrical revenue target is now a floor, he said 'It is a floor.' The 2030 plan assumed 6% to 9% organic growth, a 28% segment margin and a 32% Electrical Americas margin; including this year's guidance 'we're going to reach already 33%'. The plan conservatively baked in only 17% data-center growth, versus eight consecutive quarters of data-center growth beyond 35% (the last one 65%), and excluded the $13 billion of acquisitions and the Mobility separation; he expects a mid-cycle review 'to the upside' next year.
quarterly_data.figure: $31 billion 2030 Electrical revenue target 'a floor'; 2030 plan baked in 17% data-center growth vs eight quarters above 35%

quarterly_data.signal: 800V DC and content (Ruiz): for the medium-voltage solid-state transformer (accelerated by the Resilient Power acquisition) Eaton has '10 prototypes that were committed' - 10 prototype orders from hyperscalers, multi-tenant data centers and silicon providers - is preparing its UPS lines to produce UPS and solid-state transformers flexibly, and sees larger bids coming in the second half of the year. He claims leadership in all four 800V blocks (solid-state transformer, DC breakers, power electronics/UPS, liquid cooling via Boyd) and chairs or co-chairs safety and code discussions. Content per megawatt moved from $1.5 million in cloud to $3 million in AI before Boyd and $3.4 million with Boyd; 800V reference designs agreed with NVIDIA are 'still a moving target', so $3.4 million remains the planning number.
quarterly_data.figure: 10 committed solid-state transformer prototype orders; content $1.5 million per MW (cloud) to $3 million (AI) to $3.4 million with Boyd

quarterly_data.signal: Boyd and Fibrebond (Ruiz): Boyd has 350 design engineers plus 150 engineers who turn designs into producible units; Boyd revenue was $1.1 billion last year and guidance was adjusted to 1.8 this year - 'I'll be shocked if they don't actually go higher than that'; very few data centers have direct-to-chip liquid cooling today. Fibrebond (modular power) produced $375 million of revenue in the 12 months before acquisition and over $600 million in the 12 months after; its existing plant is being expanded and Eaton just announced a new factory in Arkansas ('doubling the capacity once in their existing site ... and doubling again with a new site'); in Europe Eaton has a modular joint venture with NordicEPOD AS. A module can be built in 9 months versus 18 months for stick-built data-center work.
quarterly_data.figure: Boyd $1.1 billion (last year), 1.8 guidance this year, likely higher; Fibrebond $375 million to over $600 million; new Arkansas factory

quarterly_data.signal: Demand and backlog (Ruiz): he confirmed data-center orders up 85% and revenues up 65%; the data-center negotiation pipeline is up over 130% (total negotiation pipeline up 60%). Announced data-center projects were 307 gigawatts when Eaton released Q2 and '342' when checked this week, versus 50 gigawatts installed today ('between six and seven times'); most will not turn into 2027-2028 revenue - 'a longer cycle'. Electrical Global: APAC and EMEA each growing 20% organically and global energy infrastructure high teens; Boyd was half of Electrical Global backlog. Utilities: new gas-turbine generation 'is going to turn into transmission already now', and into utility distribution business for Eaton in the next couple of years. 'I don't expect a large slowdown anytime soon.'
quarterly_data.figure: data-center orders +85%, revenue +65%; data-center negotiation pipeline up over 130%; announced data-center projects 342 GW (vs 307 GW at Q2) vs 50 GW installed
